title: A colour grade look can be saved to the Library and dropped onto the timeline as a grade
goal: The compositing mock shows a grade.look preset tile in the Library. Today a colour grade can be added over the video, but a grade you have tuned cannot be kept and reused: saving it as a look and dropping that tile on the timeline (or on a grade) should bring the same grade back.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-compositing.html line 287 (libtile grade.look preset). The grade track is ColorGradeLayer.swift (a full-frame lens, adjustment colorGrade, graded by its own ColorGradeEffect in style.effects); EditorState+ColorGradeTrack.swift adds one. Split out of a-colour-grade-can-be-its-own-track-over-the-cli, whose notes named the preset but whose checklist did not.
acceptance: A picked Color Grade (on a clip or on its own track) can be saved as a look that appears as a tile in the Library
Dropping that tile on the timeline adds a Color Grade track carrying those five values; dropping it on a clip or a grade gives that clip or grade those values
A walk at Next defaults saves a look, drops it, and measures the frame graded the same as the original
